description: Search, qualify, and enrich people and companies. Use this skill whenever the user wants to find professionals, candidates, or KOLs by title, company, location, seniority, or audience; enrich known contacts with email, phone, or LinkedIn; research companies for industry, funding, tech stack, or hiring activity; look up someone's contact info; source candidates for recruiting; generate B2B lead lists; or perform background web research on people or organizations. Trigger this skill even when the user doesn't explicitly say "search" or "enrich" — any mention of finding contacts, sourcing, prospecting, looking up a person or company, or gathering business intelligence should activate it.
